DESCRIPTION.general: Required. General configuration for the Data Recovery utility.
DESCRIPTION.general.destination: Required non-empty directory path for recovery images, ddrescue map files and PhotoRec output. Supports ~; relative paths resolve from the working directory. The directory is created if needed; its physical drive is excluded from source selection.
DESCRIPTION.general.ddrescue_retries: Required integer passed to ddrescue -r for retry passes after the initial pass; 0 disables retry passes and -1 requests unlimited retries.
DESCRIPTION.general.log_destination: Required string. Directory created for TestDisk log files. Supports ~; relative paths resolve from the working directory.
